title: FR-04 Multi-Social-Channel Management
classNote: Selected existing members. Channels belong to User, not directly to CollaboratorProfile. Followers are user-entered; service updates Profile.totalFollowers after add/delete. No channel-count cap or unique channel URL/platform constraint exists. SocialPlatform is an enum, not an ORM model. JWT guard only; see FR04_CODE_ANALYSIS.md.
subtitle: Add another TikTok / Facebook / YouTube / Threads channel with followers → optionally mark primary → recalculate total followers → refresh list. No configured channel-count cap.
messages: Enter channel + followers; select primary; Add

POST /api/social-channels { platformName, channelUrl, followerCount, isPrimary: true, ... }
[isPrimary] updateMany({ collaboratorId, isPrimary: true }, { isPrimary: false })
collaboratorSocialChannel.create(): owner, platform, trimmed fields, followers, primary

Show success; close modal; reset form; loadChannels(true)

notes: Browser = SocialChannelsPage + socialService + Axios (/collaborator/profile?tab=social; also WalletPage). Initial GET is omitted. JWT runs before controller; DTO checks platform, integer followers >= 0 and boolean primary. No RolesGuard or KYC gate is bound here.

Expanded path adds a new primary channel. If isPrimary is false, skip clearing old flags. Multiple channels on one platform are allowed; no count cap or unique URL/platform constraint is defined. Followers are entered manually; no OAuth/platform follower lookup or channel-ownership verification runs.

Profile total is recalculated using SUM over all owned rows after add/delete; absent profile is not created (updateMany count 0). Channel, primary reset and aggregate/profile writes are separate, not a transaction. A later failure can leave earlier writes committed; concurrent calls do not guarantee one primary.

DELETE /social-channels/:id and PATCH /:id/primary read the channel, return 404 if absent or 403 for another owner. Delete is permanent, recalculates totals and does not choose a replacement primary. setPrimary clears old flags then marks the selected row; general URL/follower editing has no endpoint here.

UI offers TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, Threads and Zalo; the API enum also accepts Telegram, Shopee Video, Lemon8 and Other. First-row display fallback is not a stored primary flag. Channel rows reference User; no Profile-to-channel foreign key exists. Duplicate rows can double-count followers.
